### ✨ 本次更新
🤖 AI
- **A新增AI开关**：考虑到部分用户可能不喜欢AI功能，新增AI开关，默认开启，如不需要，请前往AI导航栏关闭
🐛 修复与优化
- **国际化**：国际化持续优化。
---
### ✨ What's New
🤖 AI
- **AI on customization**: Considering that some users may not like the AI function, a new AI switch is added, which is on by default, if you don't need it, please go to the AI navigation bar to turn it off. 🐛 Bug Fixes & Improvements
- **i18n**: Continuous optimization of i18n.

### ✨ 本次更新
#### 🎨 视觉体验 * **AI 配置界面重塑**：全面优化了 AI 设置页面的 UI 布局。通过精细化调整控件间距与视觉层级，使大模型参数配置过程更加直观、清晰，提升了整体交互的沉浸感。
#### 🌍 国际化适配 * **多语言场景补完**：对应用内部分遗漏场景进行了深度的国际化（i18n）校对与补充。确保在不同语言环境下，UI 文本展示更准确，消除文案溢出或语义模糊问题。
--- ### ✨ What‘s New #### 🎨 UI/UX Enhancements * **Refined AI Settings Interface**: Reimagined the AI configuration panel with a focus on visual hierarchy and control layout. The new design streamlines the parameter adjustment process, making the setup experience more intuitive and professional.
#### 🌍 Internationalization * **Expanded Multilingual Support**: Completed internationalization (i18n) supplements for specific modules and edge-case scenarios. This ensures consistent, accurate, and localized text rendering across all supported languages, preventing UI clipping or translation gaps.

### ✨ 本次更新
🤖 AI 能力重磅上线
- **引入强大 AI 引擎**：剪贴板全面进化！现已原生支持图片文字识别 (AI OCR)，并无缝接入 Claude、DeepSeek、ChatGPT、Gemini 及所有兼容 OpenAI 接口的大模型。 - **自定义 AI 技能菜单**：你的提示词就是快捷菜单！支持完全自定义 AI 操作指令，打造专属工作流。同时系统内置多款实用预设，助你开箱即用。
🐛 修复与优化
- **链接解析优化**：修复了链接为纯文本格式时，仍会错误触发元数据 (metadata) 网络请求的 Bug，提升后台运行效率。
---
### ✨ What's New
🤖 AI Powers Up Your Clipboard
- **Powerful AI Integration**: Supercharge your clipboard with new AI capabilities, including built-in Image AI OCR. Seamlessly supports Claude, DeepSeek, ChatGPT, Gemini, and all OpenAI-compatible models. - **Custom AI Skills**: Your prompts become your menu items! Fully customize your AI actions to build your own workflow, or get started instantly with our built-in system prompt presets.
🐛 Bug Fixes & Improvements
- **Text-Only URL Fix**: Fixed a bug where metadata network requests were incorrectly triggered for URLs formatted as plain text, improving overall efficiency.
